description:
Talon is running in the system tray (bottom-right corner of the taskbar). The Talon community command set is installed with a help system that provides a searchable GUI listing all available voice commands.

Your task is to:
1. Right-click the Talon icon in the system tray to open its context menu
2. Navigate to 'Scripting' and then click 'Open ~/.talon' to open the Talon user configuration directory in Windows Explorer
3. In the Explorer window that opens, navigate into the 'user' folder, then into the 'community' folder, then into the 'core' folder to browse the core command files
4. Verify you can see the subdirectories like 'keys', 'edit', 'modes', 'help', etc.

This task verifies that Talon is properly installed and the community command set directory structure is accessible through the system tray menu.
